description:
Senior Software Engineer – Oracle SQL/PLSQL Developer Location

 Hybrid / Onsite

 Job Summary

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer – Oracle SQL/PLSQL Developer to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Oracle database technologies, data modeling, performance tuning, ETL processes, and enterprise application development. This role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to design scalable data solutions, and experience working in Agile environments.

 The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of mission-critical applications while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.

 Key Responsibilities

 
 Design, develop, and maintain complex Oracle SQL and PL/SQL solutions.

 Perform data analysis, data modeling, and database design for enterprise applications.

 Design and implement scalable data APIs and data integration solutions.

 Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing, and performance monitoring.

 Develop, maintain, and support batch processing jobs using ETL technologies and scheduling tools.

 Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end solutions.

 Translate business requirements, use cases, and user stories into technical designs and implementations.

 Participate in application architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews.

 Ensure software quality through automated testing, validation, and continuous integration practices.

 Mentor team members and promote engineering best practices across development teams.

 Support production deployments, troubleshooting, and ongoing system enhancements.

 Document technical designs, implementation details, and operational procedures.

 
 Required Qualifications

 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

 7+ years of experience in database development and enterprise software engineering.

 Expert-level knowledge of Oracle SQL and PL/SQL programming.

 Strong experience in data analysis, data modeling, and database design.

 Expertise in database performance tuning and optimization.

 Experience developing and managing ETL processes and batch jobs.

 Strong understanding of scalable application design principles.

 Experience implementing automated testing for database applications.

 Knowledge of CI/CD methodologies and software delivery practices.

 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

 Strong verbal and written communication skills.

 Preferred Qualifications

 
 Experience working with cloud-enabled enterprise data platforms.

 Exposure to Snowflake and modern cloud data warehouse technologies.

 Experience building distributed and high-availability systems.

 Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and event-driven architectures.

 Experience in financial services, asset management, banking, insurance, or other highly regulated industries.

 Experience leading small to mid-sized technical teams.

 
 Leadership Expectations

 
 Provide technical leadership and guidance during solution design and implementation.

 Mentor and coach engineers to improve technical capabilities and delivery excellence.

 Drive engineering best practices, coding standards, and quality initiatives.

 Promote collaboration across globally distributed teams.

 Influence architectural decisions and technology strategy.

 
 Core Competencies

 
 Database Architecture & Design

 Data Engineering

 Problem Solving & Critical Thinking

 Agile Delivery

 Continuous Learning & Innovation

 Customer-Focused Solution Delivery

 
 What Success Looks Like

 
 Delivering scalable, high-performance database solutions.

 Improving application reliability, efficiency, and maintainability.

 Driving automation across testing, deployment, and operational processes.

 Leading successful implementation of data-driven initiatives and modernization efforts.

 Contributing to a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 
 This role is ideal for an experienced Oracle SQL/PLSQL professional who enjoys solving complex data challenges, building enterprise-scale solutions, and leading technical initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 35,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 123,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is not available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post
